title: Birostrated
summary: BIROS'TRATED, a. [L. bis, twice, and rostrum, a beak.] Having a double beak, or process resembling a beak. The capsule is bilocular and birostrated.

inlines.v: BIROS'TRATED, a. [L. bis, twice, and rostrum, a beak.] Having a double beak, or process resembling a beak. The capsule is bilocular and birostrated.
